mapper.select: SELECT create_time,create_user_id,type,serial_number, bom_version as version,bom_id,id AS bomHistoryId FROM product_bom_history WHERE bom_id=#{bomId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY version DESC

SELECT pbh.id AS bomHistoryId, pbh.bom_version AS bomVersion, pbs.parent_sku_id AS parentSkuId, pbs.parent_sku_no AS parentSkuNo, pbs.sku_id AS skuId, pbs.sku_no AS skuNo, pbs.quantity AS quantity, pbi.bom_version AS thisBomVersion, pbi.type AS type FROM product_bom_history pbh INNER JOIN product_bom_sku_history pbs ON pbh.id = pbs.bom_history_id AND pbs.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_bom_info pbi ON pbh.bom_id = pbi.id AND pbi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pbh.is_deleted = FALSE AND pbh.id IN
#{bomHistoryId}
